Oneliner

Demonstrate technologies for larger satellites including CMOS and CCD sensors.
Description

Demonstration of new electronics or mechanism usable for 50-kg microsatellites, which are CMOS color sensor, CCD color sensor, CCD star sensor, and film deployment mechanism.

Failure cause Assumed that the frequency lock function of on-board receiver was easily terminated because the satellite rotation speed was fast.
